title: GABA, Hypotaurine and Taurine Transport in Brain Slices from Developing Mouse

sections.abstract: <jats:p>The kinetics and sodium-dependence of γ-aminobutyric acid (GABA), hypotaurine and taurine uptake were analyzed in cerebral slices prepared from mice of different postnatal ages. The maximal velocities of transport (V) and the K<sub>m</sub> constants for the high-affinity uptake all decreased with age, whereas the developmental changes in the low-affinity uptake were exactly opposite. Both high- and low-affinity uptakes were sodium-dependent in all age groups. The general patterns of developmental changes were similar with all three amino acids, in keeping with the assumption of a common transport system for all of them.</jats:p>
